documents.title: Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30, 2026
Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of Unaudited Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter Ended June 30, 2026

analysis.summary: Pix Transmissions Limited reported a marginal decline in consolidated total income to Rs. 59,977.44 lakhs for FY 2026, compared to Rs. 60,704.20 lakhs in the previous year. Profit after tax also saw a slight decrease, moving from Rs. 11,287.63 lakhs to Rs.

guidance.claim: The company expects a GDP growth rate of 6.3% for FY 2025-26.
guidance.quote: We continue to retain our position as the world’s fastest growing major economy with GDP growth pegged at 6.3% in FY 2025-26.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is expanding its market share in the domestic market and maintaining its position as a market leader in the industrial segment.
demand_outlook.quote: However, I’m pleased to report that we continue to expand our market share at home and fortify our position as the market leader in the industrial segment.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested Rs. 495.92 lakhs in energy conservation equipment during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: The total capital investment made in energy conservation equipment during the year amounts to ` 495.92 lakhs

capex_expansion.claim: The company has been building production capacity to seize potential growth opportunities.
capex_expansion.quote: We have been building our capabilities be it in terms of production capacity or financial resources so as to seize any potential opportunities that may arise in order to fuel our growth.

margins_costs.claim: The company is experiencing volatility in raw material prices linked to crude oil and increased import costs due to rupee depreciation.
margins_costs.quote: Due to the current conflict in West Asia, not only are we experiencing heightened volatility in the prices of raw materials (linked to crude), but their availability also seems to be impacted. To exacerbate matters, the depreciation in the Indian Rupee is also pushing up the price of imports.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is actively reducing debt and bolstering reserves.
capital_allocation.quote: Furthermore, we continue to pare down debt where possible whilst bolstering reserves.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of Rs. 9 per equity share for FY 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has recommended a final dividend of Rs. 9/- (90%) per equity share of Rs.10 each.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflict in West Asia has negatively impacted raw material availability and pricing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Due to the current conflict in West Asia, not only are we experiencing heightened volatility in the prices of raw materials (linked to crude), but their availability also seems to be impacted.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced challenges from domestic disruptions in May 2025 and U.S. tariffs on its products.
risks_headwinds.quote: We tried to bridge the shortfall by furthering our presence in the domestic market along with the exploration of new geographies internationally. And just when we felt we had turned a corner, the situation in West Asia dampened momentum.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that wars spanning geographies and tariff-wars have created volatility and uncertainty in global trade.
risks_headwinds.quote: In 2025, not only are we plagued with wars spanning geographies but the tariff-wars have added a whole new dimension to how countries will trade with each other in the times to come.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to maintain the strength of its balance sheet.
management_commitments.quote: I can confidently state that our Balance Sheet has never looked stronger and all efforts are underway to maintain its strength.

management_commitments.claim: The company will pay a remuneration of Rs. 85,000 plus taxes to the Cost Auditor for FY 2026-27.
management_commitments.quote: M/s Manisha & Associates, Cost Accountants, Nagpur, the cost auditors appointed by the Board of Directors of the Company, to conduct the audit of the cost records of the Company for the financial year ending 31st March, 2027 be paid remuneration of Rs. 85,000/- (Rupees Eighty Five Thousand only) plus applicable taxes

management_commitments.claim: The company will shortly embark upon its solar power project.
management_commitments.quote: Moreover, we will shortly be embarking upon our solar power project which is a testament to our commitment to sustainability.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
